results.name: Retro GameCube Console (Mid Poly Prop)
results.description:
A mid‑poly 3D model of the classic Nintendo GameCube console, built with clean hard‑surface topology and accurate proportions.
Designed for real‑time use in engines like Unity, Unreal, and VRChat, with enough detail to hold up in close‑up shots without being overly dense.

**Features:**
Accurate controller ports, memory card slots, and top‑lid detailing
Ideal for retro environments, game props, or showcase renders
Suitable for real‑time engines and mid‑poly workflows

results.name: Xbox Logo
results.description:
The Xbox is a home video game console and the first installment in the Xbox series of consoles manufactured by Microsoft. It was released on November 15, 2001 in North America, followed by Australia, Europe and Japan in 2002. It was Microsoft's first foray into the gaming console market. It is a sixth generation console, and competed with Sony's PlayStation 2 and Nintendo's GameCube. It was also the first console produced by an American company since the Atari Jaguar ceased production in 1996.

Info Link: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Xbox_(console)

results.name: Hermione Granger (CoS, GameCube/Xbox)
results.description: The model used for Hermione Granger in the Nintendo GameCube and Xbox version of Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets’ video-game adaptation. I extracted this using **[this](https://github.com/metallicafan212/HarryPotterUnrealWiki/tree/master/Other/Console%20Model%20and%20Texture%20Exporter)** python script. It unfortunately doesn’t have any rigging.

results.name: Harry Potter (CoS, GameCube/Xbox)
results.description:
The model used for Harry Potter himself in the Nintendo GameCube and Xbox version of Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets’ video-game adaptation. I extracted this using **[this](https://github.com/metallicafan212/HarryPotterUnrealWiki/tree/master/Other/Console%20Model%20and%20Texture%20Exporter)** python script. It unfortunately doesn't have any rigging.

It also includes the Godric Griffyndor sword, 'shadow' model and the flame effect, though I hid em' for the preview, plus also including his shape keys for his facials.
